title: Language Generation Models Can Cause Harm: So What Can We Do About It? An Actionable Survey
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a survey and does not introduce a new benchmark. It discusses harms from language models broadly, including the perpetuation of discriminatory stereotypes and biases against disadvantaged groups based on religion.
findings: As a survey paper, it summarizes existing research, noting that language models can reinforce discriminatory stereotypes and perpetuate biases against groups based on religion. It specifically cites research identifying persistent anti-Muslim bias in large language models.
